title: Fixed Point Engineering of Quantum Batteries
summary: We develop, in the context of open quantum systems, a general formalism to build completely positive and unital (CPU) maps that have a desired fixed point. In contrast to quantum channels, these maps act on observables, not on states. As the CPU maps will have a known observable as their fixed point, we know by construction that in the asymptotic limit the map will yield a constant observable.
